2) Shadow choreography: designate a primary + shadow for each panel. Shadow must be able to join within 20 minutes and hold questions list. Shadow will be the designated calendar "backup" and the primary keeps the slot. If primary cancels <4 hours, swap in shadow and flag recruiter.
3) Fallback order: Senior SME > Staff Eng > Product TL > External consultant (last resort).

I'll create a small "panel cover matrix" and drop into Drive. Monica — can you take the late Tue/early Wed slots? Kim, can you do one of the afternoons but prefer not to book over 3pm PST.
